subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Dichloro(dppe)nickel（NiCl₂(dppe)）？
A. Square planar
B. Tetrahedral
C. Octahedral
D. Trigonal planar
explanation: Square planar. Covalent count: Ni (group 10) 10 e; 1 × dppe (L₂) 4 e; 2 × Cl (X) 2 e: 16 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −2 in all and the complex is neutral, so the metal is Ni(II), d⁸; d⁸ + 8 e from the ligands = 16 e.
